    // One vertex per edge; one face per original face plus one per original vertex.
    Ambo(self: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
                self.UndirectedEdgeMidpoints,
                Concatenate(
                    self.FaceCount.MapRange(f => self.AmboFaceOfFace(f)),
                    self.VertexCount.MapRange(v => self.AmboFaceOfVertex(VertexIndex(v)))));
